sources.title: CIA World Factbook · archived country profile

recognition: Self-governing state in free association with New Zealand.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Governor-General of New Zealand Cindy KIRO (since 21 October 2021); the UK and New Zealand are represented by New Zealand High Commissioner Mark GIBBS (since 5 March 2024); Prime Minister Dalton TAGELAGI; also referred to as premier (since 10 June 2020)
economy: upper-middle-income self-governing New Zealand territorial economy; environmentally fragile; massive emigration; post-pandemic tourism rebound; postage stamps, small-scale agricultural processing, and subsistence farming; most recent Asian Development Bank member GDP (PPP): $18.7 million (2021 est.).
military: no regular indigenous military forces; Niue Police Department
origin: 19 October 1974 (Niue became a self-governing state in free association with New Zealand)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
